name: Boids
description: Flocking birds in 3D: cohesion, alignment, separation.

name: 3D Life
description: Conway-style cellular automaton on a 3D grid.

name: Creatures
description: Four-legged walkers on bumpy Perlin terrain: a JSON body, joint motors and an oscillator.

name: 2D Life (fast path)
description: Conway's Life on a flat grid using whole-grid field operations instead of a per-cell rule.

name: Neural agents
description: Each agent has its own neural network brain, kept as per-agent state arrays: weights and a memory.

name: Ants
description: Foraging ants lay scent on a ground layer: two entity sets (agents and cells) in one world, trails form by themselves.

name: Sheepdog (you drive)
description: Drive the dog with W A S D and herd sheep. Two sets of agents, a cross-set sensor, ctx.blend, and keyboard input.

name: Epidemic on a network
description: S-I-R contagion across a small-world graph of people.

name: Epidemic on a grid
description: The very same contagion script, now running on a grid of cells.

name: Market on a network
description: Traders with cash and goods buy from the cheapest neighbor; trades are atomic exchanges, prices adapt.

name: Robot from a URDF
description: A four-legged robot converted from a URDF file (robot.urdf) and walked by a script.

name: Characters that ask a language model
description: Each character's slow think() asks Claude where to go; answers are logged and replayable. Needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.

name: Creature body search
description: Leg length is a param used inside the body's geometry, so an experiment can search body shape and gait together.

name: Scouts that look
description: Each scout has a camera: a top-down picture of what is around it. Its think() shows the picture to a vision model and asks where to go; it is never told where the food is.

name: A trained network steers the crowd
description: Walkers steered by an ONNX model, run as one batch per tick. Swap in your own network (a path, a URL or a Hugging Face file). Runs and replays without the model.

name: Creatures with a modeled body
description: The walking creature, but its torso is drawn from a glTF model (beetle.glb) instead of a box. Physics still uses the box; only the picture changes.
